crm_notes: Customer: developer platform that ships IDE copilots for mid-market SaaS customers
Primary interest: reproducible code completion and predictable rollouts (model/version pinning)
Key ask: be able to pin exact model revision per client release and reproduce completions for regression testing
Target metrics: per-token latency < 60ms for local completions, 95th pctl; tail latency critical
Throughput: bursts to 300 concurrent completions per region during releases
Rollout model: staged canaries (2% -> 10% -> 50%) with automatic rollback on eval gate failure
Eval gates: unit-test pass rate on generated code, compile/run ratio, edit-distance vs golden completions, developer acceptance rates
They require audit logs for model selection decisions, and ability to export eval results into their CI
Preference: open-weight model family (Llama-like) with Redwood-managed quantized variants; fallback path to smaller model under load
Canary plan: Redwood to provide canary image tied to a model tag + deterministic random seed option for reproduceable tests
SE notes: need to show stable KV-cache behavior across identical requests and demonstrate rollout tooling (canaries + A/B) in Console
Quote from CTO: 'We need the exact same completion when we pin to a commit — reproducibility is mandatory for CI gating.'
poc_scope: Goal: validate model/version pinning + canary rollout workflow for IDE copilot product
Deliverables: pinned model artifact, canary routing policy, eval-gate integration with their CI, observability dashboard
Success criteria: deterministic completions for 95% of prompts across 5 runs; no production regressions in canary window
technical_requirements: Deterministic repeatability: ability to re-run historical completions against pinned model revisions
Rollout controls: fine-grained % splits, region-aware routing, automatic fallback to pre-approved model variants
Eval integration: run prompt-suite in their CI and fail rollout if metrics degrade beyond thresholds
Latency SLOs: 95th < 60ms for single-line completions; burst scaling with reserved capacity
Observability: token-level cost and latency per route, per-model dashboards, and audit trail for model switch events
notes_brief: Evaluation focused on reproducible code completions with canary rollouts and eval gates; security + residency are deal drivers.
